comments.@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans: Not imported by any source file. It is the provenance of public/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin.woff2, which was copied out of it once. Kept as a devDependency so the font can be re-subsetted or updated reproducibly: cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans/files/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-wght-normal.woff2 public/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin.woff2. Safe to remove entirely if you never intend to update the font.
